text:
maria: async standup — quick update: finished the kernel latency sweep on small-medium models (gpt-small/gpt-medium variants). uploaded results here: https://drive.redwood/results/kernel-sweep-1919.csv. did: ran 8 configs (batch sizes, prefetch on/off, kv-eviction thresholds). blocker: KV eviction still causing intermittent 99th pct latency spikes when sequence >1024 on A100s; can't reproduce locally with synthetic short sequences. needs someone to run longer tails on a dedicated node. today: bisect kernel change that touched prefetch ordering, and run a 1h continuous workload with PREFETCH_SIZE=256 and KV_EVICTION=low to compare.

jon: thanks. quick q — which CUDA/cu* driver combo were you testing with? also can you paste a representative eviction log? :mag:

maria: CUDA 12.2, cuDNN 9.1, runtime build: kernel-v1.21+opt. here's a short log snippet showing the spike:
```
[2026-03-15 03:12:42] INFO kv_cache: evict start shard=3 policy=LRU freed=120kb
[2026-03-15 03:12:42] WARN kernel: batch=24 seq=2048 tail-latency=312ms
[2026-03-15 03:12:42] WARN kv_cache: eviction-blocked by inflight-reads=8
[2026-03-15 03:12:42] ERROR kernel: spawn_prefetch timeout after 150ms
```

akshay: I'll spin up a repro on dev-gpu-4 and run the long-tail test. notes:
- set KV_EVICTION=aggressive to force churn
- try PREFETCH_SIZE=128 and 256
- run `wrk -t32 -c200 -d1800s http://dev-gpu-4:8080/generate` for a stress window
I'll post logs in ~30m.

lucy: re: batching — did you try per-model `max_microbatch=8` vs `16`? last week I saw throughput drop when microbatch threshold was lowered; could be collision between microbatch flush and eviction timers. PR #2384 (perf: microbatch drain tuning) might help, pinged there.

maria: yes i ran microbatch 8/16/32; 16 looked best for p50 but 99th still bad. linking PR #2384 here: https://git.redwood/pr/2384. i also noted kernel change commit `3f2b9c` that reordered prefetch->evict call in hot path — want to check bisect on that.

dmitri: reviewed PR 2390 (kv: reduce lock scope) — left two comments about lockless queue fallback and a potential ABA on pointer recycle. if we can merge a safe variant it might reduce eviction stalls.

jon: small question — are we seeing the same on Dedicated staging nodes or only on host-dev? if only on some hardware, might be a kernel/hw interaction.

maria: primarily on staging-dedicated-A100-2 and one customer repro on dedicated. not seeing on small gpu-dev (rtx6000) in org. suspect A100 mem allocator pressure + prefetch ordering.

akshay: started workload run. command I used:
```
export PREFETCH_SIZE=256
export KV_EVICTION=low
python infra/perf/run_workload.py --model gpt-medium --seq 2048 --duration 3600 --concurrency 16 --out /tmp/akshay-run.log
```
Posting logs once complete. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

lucy: FYI I'm adding a short eval to Redwood Optimize to track 99th token latency vs eviction rate so we get automated alerts when it drifts.

sre-bot: deploy scheduled: canary rollout kernel-v1.22 on staging at 2026-03-15T22:00:00Z (notify eng-runtime). :rocket:

maria: thanks all — @akshay please ping when logs up, i'll start the bisect in parallel. if anyone can review my bisect script (infra/perf/bisect_kernel.sh) that'd be great.

jon: will take a look at the script in ~1h. good luck! :thumbsup!
